teaser: The gate latch at the dog park never quite catches, so you check it twice, once with your hand and once with your eyes, before letting the leash go slack. Life path 2 and the ISTP type meet right there, in that quiet double-check. The 2 wants harmony held in place; the ISTP wants to know exactly how the latch works before trusting it to hold. In this crossing, peace is not felt as a mood so much as tested as a mechanism, something walked around and leaned on before it gets called settled.
